why_this_file_exists: The round-1 review (independent_review_round1.json, verdict ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATIONS) requires two things of the registration itself: P2 says 'correct that bullet when the row is registered' and P1 says the row should state its own pass ratio. receipt.json was read and hashed by that review, so its bytes stay untouched and the corrections land here, in a new file, as the frozen rule requires. Every number below was recomputed by this executor from the shipped schema and the pinned probe files, not copied from the review.

schema_recount.note_on_the_reviews_tally: The review says the guard 'checks 7 of the 23 result bodies and skips 16'. This executor's recount agrees on the 16 skipped and on 7 code paths reached; of those 7, six carry a non-empty required list, so six are graded by real requirements and the seventh passes through with an empty want. The substance of the finding is unaffected and is accepted.

verification_command_pass_ratio.executor_position: The red runs fail loudly with named assertion ids and never pass, so the gate cannot launder a broken build; but it is not deterministic and must not be used as a sole regression gate for W13-99, C26, or any later card until the browser phase waits on a condition rather than a timer.
verification_command_pass_ratio.not_claimed: This executor did not re-run the eight-run population; the three-run record on disk is what it can attest to directly.
